text.tspan: Theoretical Test Questions for the Learner’s Licence
Theoretical Test Questions for the Learner’s Licence
On a summit of a rise
It is not safe for you to enter a public road unless
It can be done without signalling
It can be done by changing lanes
A tow bar or draw bar
Continue at the same speed and sound the horn
Reach the right hand side of the crossing
Are off the crossing and the hand held sign is taken away
